mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.section_id, s.user_id, u.username as user_name, s.language, s.content, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM challenge_submissions s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY s.created_at ASC
SELECT s.id, s.section_id, s.user_id, u.username as user_name, s.language, s.content, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM challenge_submissions s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge_submissions (section_id, user_id, language, content) VALUES (#{sectionId}, #{userId}, #{language}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE challenge_submissions SET language=#{language}, content=#{content}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
